conviction_note: The baseline's 1.4% median is unusable (its own verdict is cadence_implausible - the eight matched 6-Ks are six days apart, not earnings), and this is the fiscal-year-end release that historically carries the annual dividend declaration; I take a moderate positive on a Form 4 cluster in the three weeks before the print that continues a documented chairman-and-CEO buying programme, tempered by the fact that the company's own adjusted EBITDA has been falling 19-40% year on year while headline net income is driven by non-cash IRSA revaluations.

findings.finding: Five Form 4s were filed in the five weeks before the annual print (2026-07-30 twice, 2026-08-13, 2026-08-21, 2026-08-26), continuing a documented open-market buying programme by the two Elsztain brothers (Chairman and CEO) and director Saul Zang who together bought the equivalent of ~120,000 ADS at $10.57-$11.23 between 2026-04-22 and 2026-06-05, and there is not a single Form 144 in the whole 400-day index.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json Form 4 entries dated 2026-08-26, 2026-08-21, 2026-08-13, 2026-07-30 (x2), 2026-06-05, 2026-05-21, 2026-05-15; the April-June purchase detail is in docs/967a6ce212eea3280a8162afd68eb43202019d07.txt entry dated 2026-06-10T16:14:13Z
findings.why_not_priced: Form 4s from a foreign private issuer's controlling family are indexed but never aggregated - the corpus contains no news search at all for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every sweep) and the only place the April-June buys appear is one retail post. Three more filings land in the fortnight immediately before an annual results release, which is precisely the window when insiders normally cannot trade unless they have a standing plan or high conviction. If this were priced, the stock would not still be trading at roughly the same level as the chairman's May purchase price.
findings.independence: The same corpus body records the Argentine macro backdrop that would motivate it from an independent source - Moody's upgrading Argentina from Caa1 to B3 with a positive outlook on 2026-07-21, lifting the MERVAL 1.81% - https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-profited-argentina-currency-swap-deal-treasury-chief-bessent-says-2025-11-11/

findings.finding: This is the fiscal-year-end release (year ended 30 June 2026) and at this company that is the release that carries the annual dividend proposal: the prior year distributed ARS 93,782m in cash plus IRSA shares, a stated ~8% yield, and the corpus records annual ADS distributions of $1.056 (2023) and $0.9921 (2024) with $0.50-1.00 expected this year against an $11.84 share price.
findings.why_not_priced: A dividend declaration that is 4-8% of market cap is a discrete cash event, and this issuer gets no US news coverage, no sell-side preview and no consensus in the whole capture. The size of the distribution is a function of ARS-denominated results that outside investors cannot model, so the announcement is a genuine information event rather than a formality.
findings.independence: none - this comes from the same 90-message Stocktwits body as the insider detail and should be collapsed into that source cluster.

findings.finding: The company's own reported numbers cut against the bull case the corpus repeats: adjusted EBITDA was 39.7% lower year on year in fiscal Q1 2026 and 19.0% lower in the fiscal first half, with agribusiness contributing only ARS 15,350m of ARS 137,967m, while the headline net income swing (ARS 193,932m against a prior-year loss) is attributed explicitly to 'the gain from changes in the fair value of IRSA investment properties' - a non-cash mark.
findings.corpus_ref: docs/967a6ce212eea3280a8162afd68eb43202019d07.txt, entries dated 2026-02-10T14:35:44Z and 2025-11-10T20:54:23Z (verbatim reproductions of the company's H1 FY26 and Q1 FY26 releases)
findings.why_not_priced: It is company-disclosed, so nominally priced - but every other item in the 76-item capture frames the story as record crops and record grain prices and none of them mentions that operating cash earnings have been contracting. The gap between the narrative in the observed corpus and the numbers in the company's own release is the thing worth flagging, and it is why my net number is well below the sum of the two positive findings.
findings.independence: none - same document as findings above.

baseline_tension: It agrees with the run-up (+5.5% over five sessions, +9.6% over twenty) and with 6 of 8 prior reactions being positive, so this finding is confirmatory rather than contrarian, which caps how much it can be worth.
corpus_limits: No option chain, so no implied move or skew. No news search was run for this ticker; the observable non-filing corpus is one Stocktwits thread whose substance comes largely from a single author, so the independence claims above are weak by construction and several findings share one document. The baseline's reaction history is explicitly unusable (cadence_implausible) so I have no reliable base rate for how this name trades an annual print. No Form 4 or 6-K body is stored. No item in this capture carried a non-empty tripwire_tells.
